title: FIFA Big Count 2006 — All Players (archived original table)
scope: 208 original table rows, association totals, registered/unregistered players, clubs and officials; raw facts in observations/fifa_big_count_2006.csv.
limitations: Checked-in normalized observation v2 datasets preserve the 2006 all-player, registered, unregistered, club and officials fields without treating missing cells as zero. The legacy extract is mixed-sex, does not retain per-cell direct/statistically-processed flags, and field definitions are not assumed globally identical. Earth identity reconciliation remains a separate reviewed layer.
